intent.zh: 补上一张 B 类前提注释卡（2026-11-02-render-bvh-b-class-premise-notes）scope 外的 P1 落点：在 `tests/render_sdf_reference.rs` 头部判据列表之后补 B 类前提段（CR-10/11/12/16）——上述 `<=4 ULP`、位级 depth、RGB `<=1 LSB` 与 DepthSeg 跨路径断言均为参考-前提型判据：仅在同 recipe、同编译形态、同 GPU+驱动、同 warp 版本下成立；前提不成立即不适用；不得单独作为通过依据（详见 docs/development-evidence/criteria-purpose-audit/）。同时把 `b-class-premises.md` 落点条目从『待后续小卡』更新为『已落地』。只改注释与文档，不改测试逻辑/断言/数值/参考/fixtures。
intent.en: Add the P1 landing point that was outside the previous B-class premise card's scope: in tests/render_sdf_reference.rs, after the header criteria list, add the B-class premise paragraph (CR-10/11/12/16) - the <=4 ULP, bitwise-depth, RGB<=1 LSB and DepthSeg cross-path assertions are reference-premise criteria valid only under the same recipe, same compilation form, same GPU+driver and same warp version; when a premise fails the criterion is not applicable and never a standalone pass basis (see docs/development-evidence/criteria-purpose-audit/). Also update the b-class-premises.md landing-point entry from 'pending follow-up card' to 'landed'. Comments and docs only; no test logic/assertions/values/references/fixtures change.

acceptance: `tests/render_sdf_reference.rs` 头部判据列表后新增 B 类前提段（CR-10/11/12/16），文字与 `criteria-purpose-audit/b-class-premises.md` 规则一致；`b-class-premises.md` 的落点条目标注为已落地。
只改注释与文档：测试逻辑/断言/容差数值/参考/fixtures 零改动；`src/` 零改动；四门禁（fmt/clippy/clippy-cuda/unit）+ `--no-run` 通过并报 `gate.unit = cargo test --locked` 口径计数。
